material_changes: original PMMA-like index to user PMMA nd/Vd
original polystyrene to user PC nd/Vd
original n1.734 V51 glass to user FDS18W
provenance.limits: The original patent is about f/1.4, not this aperture/NA. Material, aperture and clearance changes break original correction; full real-ray optimization is required.

initial_aperture_fit.policy: Coupled mode: equal front/back radius, capped by smaller original face. Independent mode: each face capped by its own original radius. Reserve max(0.30mm,2% of maximum sampled footprint). Front-diameter50 first front face remains exactly25mm radius; coupled mode keeps both first-element faces25mm.
initial_aperture_fit.limitation: Sampled nonnegative Y fields in a rotationally symmetric system. No rigorous extremum proof between fields/rings/azimuths and no manufacturing tolerance allocation. Dense downstream qualification remains necessary.
initial_aperture_fit.mechanical_profile: Only clear semi-diameters are specified. Mechanical outer diameter, edge/chamfer or tapered solid profile is unspecified; independent clear faces are not manufacturing certification. The wave model treats its declared last clear surface extent as the boundary constraint; moving that boundary with identical rays is model sensitivity, not a physical improvement.
initial_aperture_fit.reason: All sampled statuses and transmitted optical histories preserved
